messages.subject: General confusion
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I haven't heard much about my project in quite a while. In all honesty there are so many links and groups/email chains to keep track of, I don't even know where to start. I managed to find this dashboard: https://summerofcode.withgoogle.com/dashboard/proposals/shared/?sp-page_size=100&sp-is_complete&sp-organization=5111129224773632
However I cannot see my project on there. I can only assume that this means my project was not accepted since I cannot see anywhere to add it either.

Best regards,

Nathan

messages.subject: Re: General confusion
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I see that there were two students interested in poorman but I cannot find any proposal about your project on the dashboard.
Maybe no student submitted their oficial proposal through google? One of the links provided by the students is no longer available.

I take the opportunity to thank you for writing such an excellent package.

Best regards,

Lluís

messages.subject: R-GSOC 2022 wiki created
messages.body_plain: Hi all, R-GSOC 2021 projects have been announced. If you had a project idea this year that did not work out for whatever reason, feel free to copy it over to the wiki for next year, which I just created https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2022/wiki/table%20of%20proposed%20coding%20projects

messages.subject: Welcome to GSoC 2021
messages.body_plain:
Hello

Welcome all the students who have been selected to participate this year for GSoC. We are excited to work with you all.

I am sure you are in touch with the mentors for the community bonding period. In case you are facing any communication problems, please let us know here.

Good luck.

Vijay

--
---
Vijay Barve
GSoC :R Project Org Admin
https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/
---
